subject.title: fix(qqbot): limit channel API targets to configured groups [AI]

question: What should qqbot_channel_api do when QQBot group-chat scope is configured but the raw API path targets QQ guild/channel resources?
rationale: The current config surface names QQ group OpenIDs, while the raw API path carries QQ guild/channel IDs, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent authorization boundary.

options.title: Fail closed for scoped groups
options.body: Block raw guild/channel API calls whenever QQBot group scope is narrowed unless wildcard scope is configured, and document that behavior without pretending group IDs match guild/channel IDs.

options.title: Add a dedicated target allowlist
options.body: Create a maintainer-approved guild/channel API target-scope surface with migration/docs/tests before allowing scoped resource calls.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the current raw API behavior unchanged until a broader QQBot tool-scope/security design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Fail closed for scoped groups
recommendation.body: Block raw guild/channel API calls whenever QQBot group scope is narrowed unless wildcard scope is configured, and document that behavior without pretending group IDs match guild/channel IDs.
